name: Alex Rivera
bio: Architectural nerd by day, amateur sourdough baker by weekend. Looking for someone who can introduce me to obscure indie cinema or challenge me to Mario Kart. Always down for late-night street tacos and gallery hops.

prompts.answer: Having someone who will always let you pick the playlist on road trips, but will mercilessly critique your font choices on restaurant menus.

1. I have an accidental collection of 42 house plants.
2. I once cooked cacio e pepe for Pedro Pascal.
3. I can solve a Rubik's cube under 45 seconds.
The smell of rain on warm asphalt, finding a first edition paperback at a thrift shop, and the first sip of an iced oat latte on Saturday morning.
